criterion.definition: AI-N is comparable to the 10k reference if, on paired image-level differences [metric(AI-N, ref) - metric(independent 10k, ref)] pooled over the validation evaluation seeds (2026-2029), the lower bound of the 95% bootstrap CI (2000 resamples over images) is >= -delta, for BOTH SSIM and Pearson r
criterion.decided_on: validation set; the minimum successful N is frozen before the test set is opened
criterion.test_set: the same rule is applied once to the 74 test images; N is not changed after seeing test results
